statement: Target is ANJIA AJL33PQ0866 based on FH8626V100 with dual GC1054 MIPI sensors.
Exercised native sensor mode is 1280x720 at 25 fps and product default lens is WIDE.
Cold-boot dual-sensor visibility requires the validated GPIO5 reset/bootstrap sequence before sensor/media startup; without it TELE was not physically visible.
Captured stock selector order is logical lens 1 -> sensor 2 -> assert GPIO14 before deasserting GPIO4, and logical lens 0 -> sensor 1 -> assert GPIO4 before deasserting GPIO14.
Stock GC1054 path maps libgc1054_mipi.so/libmipi.so and uses the vendor sensor/I2C wrapper; retained reverse identifies ioctl request values 0x704, 0x706 and 0x707.
Accepted low-level PTZ backend is /dev/fh_pwm; board motor operation was physically validated after correcting swapped motor connectors.
Stock pipeline exposes scaled output modes beyond the exercised 1280x720 sensor mode, establishing downstream scaling in the media path.
Majestic is the preferred product path; retained evidence proves process start on FH8626V100 but does not yet establish reproducible VI, VENC, sustained RTSP or ISP acceptance.
Native Divinus reference path retains known source-parity gaps in ISP runtime/statistics handling, frontend address-domain semantics, frame-wait behavior and RTSP fd/parser ownership.
Retained GC1054 vendor sensor binary is stored externally with SHA-256 92a0289bb7e5774af1210458588815358192aae3c29f59e15787249724c5428d.
